`box.ttf` is an original rectangle-glyph fixture generated by
`python tests/fixtures/generate_box_font.py`. It contains no third-party font
data and uses the repository license. It exists solely to exercise atlas
packing, resource ownership, caching, kerning, Unicode layout and GPU rendering consistently on every
platform; it is not a font intended for normal application text.

The fixture has distinct A/V glyphs with a -100 unit kern pair, an empty space,
Greek Omega, Cyrillic Zhe, a CJK character and a supplementary emoji codepoint.
2048 distinct private-use rectangle glyphs exercise atlas page growth and the
cache bound without depending on system fonts or downloading assets.

Its ascent/descent span is 1500 units with a 1000-unit em square so tests catch
font-size scaling that incorrectly normalizes to line height.
